n0.text: Fennel! Thank goodness you're up. Something terrible has happened. Something... un-brie-lievable.

n1.text: Last night, a gang of rats crept into the Cheese Cave and stole the LAST WHEEL. A hundred years of rind, mould and patience, gone.

n2.text: Their leader is that rotten scoundrel, King Gorgonzolo. Wherever his gang walks, the Blue Rot creeps over my fields. Look at my poor corn!

ask.text: You're the best apprentice cheesemonger-chef this farm has ever had. (You're also the only one. But still!) Will you find the Last Wheel?

choices.text: I'll bring it home, Farmer Gouda!
Rat King? Is that a real job?
Can I have a snack first?

lore.text: Oh, it's real. He wears a crown of bottle caps and smells faintly of old blue cheese. And he is VERY good at squeaking dramatically.

snack.text: A growing kitten needs her curds, I know. Visit Chef Camembert in the farmhouse. But hurry, the Rot won't wait!

yes.text: That's my girl! Here, 50 gold for supplies. Talk to the folks around the farm: Granny Edam knows the cave's secrets, and Chef Camembert can teach you to cook with what you find. Cook it right and it'll melt the toughest rat!

rem0.text: Any luck with the Last Wheel, Fennel? The cave is north, up the hill past the big oak. Be careful of rats, crows, and... I'm told, mould with opinions.

rem1.text: Rest at a campfire if you get tired. Nothing like a toasty fire and a cheese toastie. Go on, I believe in you!
